paths.description: Public game index, representing game discovery/listing and all four trial entry links.
Representative DAILY QUIZ start template and its primary CTA.
Cookie-preserving POST replay from start to question to answer/result and next-step state.
Quiz submission without selecting an answer, representing validation and recovery.

Cross-template assessment using the index and quiz evidence; excludes sibling game internals because they are separate game implementations and the quiz is the representative high-risk interactive archetype.

findings.summary: Dark preference is ignored
findings.evidence: Dark-mode captures are pixel-identical to the light captures, and the CSS probe found no color-scheme or prefers-color-scheme rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide preference-driven light/dark surface and text tokens.

findings.summary: The quiz animation ignores reduced motion
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the scaling animation is still running with a 2,000 ms duration; CSS has no reduced-motion rule.
findings.suggestedFix: Disable the infinite scaling animation under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce.

findings.summary: Route and form state changes swap abruptly
findings.evidence: The CSS probe found no view-transition usage across the list-to-game and question/result journey.
findings.suggestedFix: Add progressive-enhancement View Transitions to route and form-state changes.

findings.summary: Long pages provide no scroll-position guidance
findings.evidence: The 2,845 CSS-pixel list has no sticky progress/header state and the probe found no scroll-state styling.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a restrained scroll progress or responsive sticky context cue.

findings.summary: Navigation changes do not cue where attention moved
findings.evidence: The multi-step quiz uses full document swaps with no directional transition or explicit focus cue in the inspected markup.
findings.suggestedFix: Move focus to the new question/result heading and add reduced-motion-safe directional transitions.

findings.summary: Pages ship desktop canvases instead of mobile layouts
findings.evidence: At a requested 360x800 viewport, the homepage reports a 1,280 CSS-pixel layout and the quiz 980 CSS pixels because both omit the viewport meta tag; screenshots show the whole desktop canvas scaled down.
findings.suggestedFix: Add width=device-width, initial-scale=1 and replace fixed 1280/1000/728/620 px shells with fluid intrinsic layouts.

findings.summary: Cards and game UI do not adapt at component level
findings.evidence: CSS uses fixed widths and the probe found no container queries; the mobile browser scales the desktop composition instead of reflowing cards.
findings.suggestedFix: Make list cards and game panels container-query components with intrinsic sizing.

findings.summary: Invalid quiz submission abandons the task
findings.evidence: Submitting without an answer returns a generic “閲覧は許可できません” permission error with only a Close link to ceres-inc.jp, losing quiz context.
findings.suggestedFix: Prevent submission until a choice is made, show an in-context Japanese error, focus it, and retain the question.

findings.summary: The quiz has a slow largest contentful paint
findings.evidence: Mobile Lighthouse measured quiz LCP at 6.5 s, FCP at 3.6 s, and performance 0.65; the trace also measured LCP at 3.84 s.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritise the hero/LCP asset and remove parser-blocking and duplicated analytics work from the critical path.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking dependencies delay quiz content
findings.evidence: The HAR confirms five VeryHigh parser-inserted stylesheets and three non-async/defer classic scripts in head; quiz LCP is slow.
findings.suggestedFix: Consolidate critical CSS, defer noncritical CSS, and defer/remove legacy scripts not needed before first render.

findings.summary: Duplicate analytics dominates the quiz payload
findings.evidence: Quiz transfers 526,848 bytes, including 337,596 third-party bytes; Lighthouse estimates 133 KiB unused across two gtag bundles.
findings.suggestedFix: Use one analytics configuration, load it after consent/idle, and remove unused jQuery UI and legacy code.

findings.summary: Homepage accent text fails WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: axe and Lighthouse report five failures: orange #ff8c00 text is 2.33:1 and red caution text is 3.56:1 against white.
findings.suggestedFix: Darken accent and caution colors to meet at least 4.5:1 for this text size.

findings.summary: Primary content lacks a main landmark
findings.evidence: axe reports landmark-one-main and region violations on both templates; the probes find only header on home and footer on quiz.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap primary content in main and keep logical headings and focus placement across each POST transition.

findings.summary: Mobile text is rendered at desktop scale
findings.evidence: The 360px screenshots scale 1280px/980px canvases down, making body and note text extremely small despite otherwise valid desktop typography.
findings.suggestedFix: Use responsive type and fluid line lengths after correcting viewport and fixed-width shells.

findings.summary: Viewport configuration prevents proper mobile reflow
findings.evidence: Both documents omit meta viewport; CDP reports visual scales of 0.28125 and 0.3673 at 360px.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a scalable viewport meta and verify reflow at 320 CSS px and 200% zoom without two-dimensional scrolling.

findings.summary: Homepage logs a failed resource request
findings.evidence: Lighthouse and HAR record a 404 for /favicon.ico on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a valid favicon or remove the implicit broken request.

findings.summary: The quiz ships obsolete platform dependencies
findings.evidence: Rendered HTML loads jQuery 1.9.1 and jQuery UI 1.10.3 synchronously; these are stale legacy libraries even though Lighthouse found no deprecation/BFCache issue.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the legacy libraries or update and defer the smallest still-required dependency.

findings.summary: Quiz metadata is incomplete
findings.evidence: The game has a descriptive title but an empty meta description; Lighthouse SEO scores that audit 0.
findings.suggestedFix: Write a unique Japanese description for each game/result template.

findings.summary: Search crawlers are blocked and mobile support is undeclared
findings.evidence: robots.txt disallows Googlebot and bingbot from all paths except /ads.txt, while both templates omit viewport meta.
findings.suggestedFix: Allow intended public routes in robots.txt and add responsive viewport metadata.

findings.summary: Indexing signals conflict or are missing
findings.evidence: The public game page emits an empty canonical; its crawler fetch returned 403; sitemap.xml is 404; robots blocks major search crawlers.
findings.suggestedFix: Emit self-referencing canonicals, publish a sitemap, return 200 to legitimate crawlers, and align robots policy.

findings.summary: Game pages lack share and entity metadata
findings.evidence: Both probes found zero JSON-LD blocks and no Open Graph metadata despite the pages representing distinct games.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate Game/SoftwareApplication or appropriate schema.org JSON-LD and Open Graph/Twitter cards.

findings.summary: Session and analytics cookies lack basic protections
findings.evidence: All six quiz cookies are not Secure and use SameSite=None; PHPSESSID is also not HttpOnly. CSP, HSTS, and nosniff are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Mark session cookies Secure, HttpOnly, and SameSite=Lax/Strict as appropriate, then add CSP, HSTS, and nosniff.

findings.summary: Duplicate analytics collect data by default
findings.evidence: The quiz contacts three known tracker origins, loads two gtag configurations plus analytics.js, and transfers 337,596 third-party bytes without visible consent controls.
findings.suggestedFix: Minimise to one analytics path, gate nonessential collection on consent, shorten retention, and document purpose.

findings.summary: Most browser-enforced defenses are absent
findings.evidence: Headers show only X-Frame-Options: deny; CSP, HSTS, nosniff, Referrer-Policy, and Permissions-Policy are missing.
findings.suggestedFix: Deploy a restrictive CSP and add HSTS, nosniff, strict-origin-when-cross-origin, and a minimal Permissions-Policy.

findings.summary: The primary quiz flow requires JavaScript and blocks no-JS users
findings.evidence: The quiz includes a noscript full-page message requiring JavaScript and hides the UI, while home content is fully server-rendered.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep the POST quiz flow functional in HTML without JavaScript and layer animation/ad checks as enhancements.

findings.summary: Anti-adblock and fragile loading logic can replace the whole experience
findings.evidence: Inline detection rewrites body content when ad probes fail and the page warns that rapid clicks or incomplete loading can break navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove destructive body rewriting; isolate optional ads/analytics and keep the core quiz independently usable.

findings.summary: Failures lead to a generic dead-end
findings.evidence: An invalid state returns a generic permission error and a Close link away from the game, with no retry/back recovery.
findings.suggestedFix: Render recoverable 4xx/network states in the game shell with retry, back, and preserved context.

findings.summary: Styles are not writing-mode resilient
findings.evidence: html lang=ja is correct, but the CSS probe found no logical properties and multiple physical left/right declarations.
findings.suggestedFix: Retain lang=ja and migrate layout spacing/positioning to logical properties.

findings.summary: Daily reset times do not identify a time zone
findings.evidence: The quiz advertises updates at 0:00, 8:00, and 16:00 and says “server time” governs updates, but exposes no zone or locale context.
findings.suggestedFix: State the authoritative zone (for example JST/Asia-Tokyo) and calculate/display schedules with explicit zone-aware data.

findings.summary: The answer form does not validate choice errors humanely
findings.evidence: Radio inputs are not required, and an empty POST produces a generic ERROR permission page rather than field-level guidance.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the group required, validate after interaction, announce the Japanese error, and preserve focus/context.

findings.summary: Images are legacy, eager, and non-responsive
findings.evidence: All eight homepage images are PNG; six below-fold images are eager, four icons are >2x display size, and no responsive sources exist.
findings.suggestedFix: Convert suitable images to AVIF/WebP, provide srcset/sizes, right-size icons, and lazy-load below-fold images.

findings.summary: Tracking and legacy scripts do disproportionate background work
findings.evidence: Two gtag bundles plus analytics.js dominate quiz bytes and issue duplicated page-view collection for a simple static form flow.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove duplicated analytics and defer the minimum consented telemetry until idle.

findings.summary: Third parties dominate a lightweight game page
findings.evidence: Third parties account for 337,596 of 526,848 transferred bytes (64%), mostly duplicate Google tags, exceeding first-party transfer.
findings.suggestedFix: Set a third-party budget and load a single analytics integration only after consent/idle.

taskList.title: Secure sessions and deploy browser defenses
Remove duplicate analytics and unblock quiz LCP
Keep quiz flow recoverable with HTML-first validation
Align crawler, canonical, sitemap, and rich metadata
Add attention-preserving transitions and scroll context
